subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Octopus and the Unknown
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Octopus and the Unknown.

hook.text: The Kraken dragged ships beneath the waves. Sailors feared the unseen tentacles of the deep.

buildup.text: Octopuses have eight arms, three hearts, and blue blood. They're so alien they fuel myths of undersea monsters.

discovery.text: Minoan pottery features octopuses prominently. Crete's sea culture saw beauty where others saw horror.

twist.text: Modern science reveals octopuses are incredibly intelligent—problem-solvers, escape artists, and tool users.

climax.text: The octopus represents the deep unknown: terrifying, intelligent, and fundamentally unlike us.

punchline.text: Eight arms. Three hearts. Zero certainty.

quiz.question: Which ancient civilization celebrated the octopus in its art?
